portInfo.description: Historic Canadian port city with rich maritime heritage, known for the Citadel, waterfront, and friendly atmosphere.

facts.significance: Major Canadian Atlantic port and cruise destination

size.portCapacity: One of Canada's largest cruise ports
size.citySize: Halifax: Population approximately 430,000 in metropolitan area

climate.description: Humid continental climate with four distinct seasons

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality and itinerary. Confirm requirements with official government sources and your cruise line before travel; rules can change.
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport usually required. Many visa-exempt visitors need an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) from the Government of Canada—confirm before you sail.
